card.name: Words before treatment or discontinuation
card.fires_on: Small words such as 'after', 'receive', 'of' or 'from' just before a word about treatment, discontinuation or a starting figure. Mostly in warnings about tuberculosis, corticosteroids or stopping therapy, plus a 'from' before a number in poverty statistics.

modes.label: Before treatment terms
modes.description: A verb or linking word right before 'treatment', 'chemoprophylaxis' or 'discontinuation of therapy'.
modes.example: During prolonged corticosteroid therapy these patients should<< receive>> chemoprophylaxis.

modes.label: After stopping therapy
modes.description: 'after' or 'of' leading into 'discontinuation' of a drug.
modes.example: generally resolving<< after>> discontinuation of therapy.

modes.label: From before a number
modes.description: The word 'from' before a starting figure in a statistic about falling or revised numbers.
modes.example: The poverty rate, however, has fallen from<< >>60% to 40%
